title: Preview scoped dynamic customer receivable evidence report
description: User scene: an authorized user selects invoice evidence fields and bounded customer/date/currency/allocation filters to preview invoice gross, explicitly allocated receipts and arithmetic remaining evidence. Reuse the ERP-074 reconciliation engine, existing customer menu permission and SalespersonDataScopeService. Apply scope inside the EF query before Count/Skip/Take and batch evidence loading; absent scope, missing menu or invalid fields fail closed. Do not claim authoritative receivable balance, payment settlement, due-date aging or collection status. Existing HTTP operation audit records reads. Development only: no new tables/migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change, or deployment. Run unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated catalog exposes only finite invoice and receipt-allocation evidence fields; preview rejects unknown fields, invalid filters and page size above 100 before reading data.

Preview requires existing customer menu permission and resolves salesperson scope on every request; existing reconciliation EF filters apply allowed customer IDs before count/paging and preserve known, unknown and over-allocated remaining states.
Tests cover authorized and out-of-scope customers, unmapped user, invalid fields, 100-row cap, receipt evidence states and no writes; document evidentiary limits and audit behavior.
